title: ConfigError wraps String, losing source error
description: reader::config::ConfigError and imap::config::ConfigError have variants Io(String), Parse(String), Validation(String). The source std::io::Error and toml::de::Error are stringified at the call site (e.map(|e| ConfigError::Io(e.to_string()))). Callers cannot match on or inspect the root cause, and backtrace/source chains are severed. Idiomatic Rust: use thiserror with #[source] fields or keep the original error type. Both crates already use thiserror elsewhere (stoa-auth); the pattern is established. Fix: replace String fields with typed sources using thiserror::Error.
